title: A Three-Polynomial Counterexample to the Generalized Effective Hypercube Nullstellensatz
summary: We give a counterexample to the proposed extension of the effective Hypercube Nullstellensatz from two polynomials to an arbitrary fixed number of polynomials. For every $n\geq1$, we construct three real polynomials in $2n+1$ variables, of degrees $2,2,1$, respectively. Each is nonzero as a function on the Boolean cube, their product vanishes on the cube, and they have no common Boolean zero.
